source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Flexential Charlotte - North publishes 3.3 MW of IT capacity across 62,589 square feet of technical space. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 3.3 MW supports roughly 82 racks; at a more modest 10 kW per rack, a typical colocation average, the same power supports roughly 330 racks. The operator has not published power-density targets for this facility, so neither figure should be read as an operator claim, only as a range of what the headroom could mean depending on workload type.

The six certifications, SOC 1 Type 2, SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, and SSAE 18, qualify this campus to host regulated financial data, payment card environments, protected health information, and audited information-security programs. No tenants are published.

Within North Carolina, this site is the site with the third-highest published IT capacity among the five facilities on this site that report a megawatt figure at all, out of 19 mapped in the state. Its 3.3 MW represents roughly 6.4 percent of the 51.47 MW published across those five facilities, and the remaining 14 mapped facilities publish no capacity figure. At that scale, Charlotte - North is a mid-tier regulated colocation site, not a hyperscale AI training campus, and the published power figure alone places an immediate ceiling on the GPU density any tenant could deploy there.
